result.topic_en: A preliminary numerical application of a new method for determining the (magnetic) inclination, using the distances e, e' of the centre of gravity from the suspension point, the oscillation times t, t', t° and the length a, which gives i ≈ 69° 9' 30".

methods.what: Relation between the oscillation time t of a pendulum or needle and the distance e of its centre of gravity from the suspension point (bar of length a)
The same relation for a second configuration, with e', t' and l'
Formula for the tangent of the inclination angle from the difference of the centre-of-gravity distances
Logarithmic numerical evaluation of tan i, giving an inclination of 69° 9' 30"
Alternative expression of tan i in terms of the oscillation times alone
